message.reasoning:
The customer asks: "Trying to figure out the timing on an annual switch before I tell finance a number." They want to know timing of switching to annual billing. According to policy DOC-002 part 2: Switching to annual takes effect immediately, charged annual rate on confirmation, prorated against any monthly charge already paid, renewal date resets to one year from the switch. So answer that.

We need to post_reply with concise answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"When you switch from a monthly to an annual plan, the change takes effect immediately. We charge the annual rate right away (prorated against any monthly amount you’ve already paid for the current period) and reset the renewal date to one year from the switch date."}
